# check models
```{r setup}
library(tidymodels)
library(glmnet)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(pbmcapply)
```

```{r load-session}
# Load session objects produced by 09-1-ml-local.R
sess <- readRDS("processed_data/session_09_1_ml_local.rds")
event_dt <- sess$event_dt # trimmed: ID, Event Type, seqnames, Variability, transcript_filter
keep_rows <- sess$keep_rows_manual
rm(sess)
gc()

# load aggregating.rda and aggregated_dt
load("processed_data/aggregating.rda")
aggregated_dt <- fread(
  "processed_data/aggregated_dt_filtered.csv.gz",
  stringsAsFactors = TRUE
)
```

```{r load-data}
event_dir <- file.path("processed_data", "event_models")

plot_dir_ev <- file.path(plot_dir, "event_models")
dir.create(plot_dir_ev, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Helper: aggregate per-event CSVs saved by worker
read_event_csvs <- function(pattern) {
  rbindlist(
    lapply(list.files(event_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE), fread),
    fill = TRUE
  )
}

# Best hyperparameters per (event, workflow)
best_params_table <- read_event_csvs("^best_params_.*\\.csv\\.gz$")
best_params_table[, ID := as.integer(ID)]
best_params_table[,
  c("feature_set", "response") := tstrsplit(wflow_id, "_", fixed = TRUE, keep = c(1L, 2L))
]

ggplot(
  best_params_table,
  aes(x = as.character(mixture), y = -log10(penalty), color = feature_set)
) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = .5) +
  facet_grid(ID ~ response == "PSI") +
  theme_bw()

# In-sample fit metrics per (event, workflow)
fit_metrics_table <- read_event_csvs("^fit_metrics_.*\\.csv\\.gz$")
fit_metrics_table[, ID := as.integer(ID)]
fit_metrics_table[,
  c("feature_set", "response") := tstrsplit(wflow_id, "_", fixed = TRUE, keep = c(1L, 2L))
]

ggplot(
  fit_metrics_table[!endsWith(.metric, "_logit")],
  aes(x = response == "PSI", y = .estimate, color = feature_set)
) +
  geom_violin(alpha = .5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_jitter(
    alpha = .3,
    position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.8, jitter.width = 0.8)
  ) +
  facet_grid(.metric ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, NA))
```

```{r create-tables}
# cv_metrics_table: per-fold metrics at selected config
cv_metrics_table <- read_event_csvs("^all_metrics_.*\\.csv\\.gz$")
cv_metrics_table[, ID := as.integer(ID)]
cv_metrics_table <- cv_metrics_table[
  best_params_table[, .(ID, wflow_id, .config)],
  on = .(ID, wflow_id, .config),
  nomatch = NULL
]
cv_metrics_table[,
  c("feature_set", "response") := tstrsplit(wflow_id, "_", fixed = TRUE, keep = c(1L, 2L))
]
cv_metrics_table[, response_type := fifelse(response == "PSI", "real", "rotated")]

# event_summary_table: robust feature count + expression bias per workflow
event_summary_table <- read_event_csvs("^event_summary_.*\\.csv\\.gz$")
event_summary_table[, ID := as.integer(ID)]
event_summary_table[,
  c("feature_set", "response") := tstrsplit(wflow_id, "_", fixed = TRUE, keep = c(1L, 2L))
]
event_summary_table[, response_type := fifelse(response == "PSI", "real", "rotated")]
event_summary_table[
  event_dt,
  on = "ID",
  c("Event Type", "Variability", "seqnames") := .(`Event Type`, Variability, seqnames)
]

# Join mean CV R²
cv_rsq <- cv_metrics_table[
  .metric == "rsq_trad_psi",
  .(mean_cv_rsq = mean(.estimate, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(ID, wflow_id)
]
event_summary_table[cv_rsq, on = .(ID, wflow_id), mean_cv_rsq := mean_cv_rsq]

# "Rotated Hit": did this event's PSI appear as a rotation in any other event?
rotation_ids <- event_summary_table[response_type == "rotated", unique(as.integer(response))]
event_summary_table[
  response_type == "real",
  rotated_hit := fifelse(ID %in% rotation_ids, "Hit by Rotation", "Not Hit")
]

# feature_table: selected features per CV fold per workflow
feature_table <- read_event_csvs("^fold_features_.*\\.csv\\.gz$")
feature_table[, ID := as.integer(ID)]
feature_table[,
  c("feature_set", "response") := tstrsplit(wflow_id, "_", fixed = TRUE, keep = c(1L, 2L))
]
feature_table[, response_type := fifelse(response == "PSI", "real", "rotated")]
feature_table[event_dt, on = "ID", c("Event Type", "Variability") := .(`Event Type`, Variability)]
feature_table[
  event_summary_table[response_type == "real", .(ID, expression_bias)],
  on = "ID",
  expression_bias := expression_bias
]

# coef_table: robust non-zero coefficients per workflow
coef_table <- read_event_csvs("^nonzero_coefs_.*\\.csv\\.gz$")
coef_table[, ID := as.integer(ID)]
coef_table[,
  c("feature_set", "response") := tstrsplit(wflow_id, "_", fixed = TRUE, keep = c(1L, 2L))
]
coef_table[, response_type := fifelse(response == "PSI", "real", "rotated")]
coef_table[event_dt, on = "ID", c("Event Type", "Variability") := .(`Event Type`, Variability)]
coef_table[
  event_summary_table[response_type == "real", .(ID, expression_bias)],
  on = "ID",
  expression_bias := expression_bias
]
coef_table[, let(c("mark", "region"), tstrsplit(feature, ";", fixed = TRUE))]
coef_table[,
  coefficient_sign := fifelse(coef > 0, "positive coefficient", "negative coefficient")
]
coef_table[,
  Response := factor(
    fifelse(response_type == "real", "Real", "Rotated"),
    levels = c("Real", "Rotated")
  )
]
coef_table[, `Event Type` := factor(`Event Type`, levels = to_analyze)]
```

```{r counting-events}
modeled_ids <- event_summary_table[
  response_type == "real" & has_model == TRUE,
  unique(ID)
]

event_counts <- rbindlist(
  list(
    Filtered = event_dt[ID %in% keep_rows, .(.N), by = .(`Event Type`)],
    Quantified = aggregated_dt[, .(N = uniqueN(ID)), by = `Event Type`],
    `No Model` = aggregated_dt[
      !ID %in% modeled_ids,
      .(N = uniqueN(ID)),
      by = `Event Type`
    ],
    `Model` = event_summary_table[
      response_type == "real" & has_model == TRUE,
      .(.N),
      by = .(`Event Type`)
    ],
    `Epigenetic\nOnly Model` = event_summary_table[
      response_type == "real" &
        expression_bias == "Epigenetic Only" &
        has_model == TRUE,
      .(.N),
      by = .(`Event Type`)
    ]
  ),
  idcol = "filtering"
)

print(event_summary_table[
  response_type == "real",
  table(expression_bias, `Event Type`)
])

ggplot(event_counts, aes(x = N, y = reorder(filtering, N))) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    text = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~`Event Type`, scales = "free_x") +
  geom_text(aes(label = N), vjust = 1.1, size = 4, angle = 90) +
  labs(x = "Number of Events", y = NULL)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir_ev, "event_counts.pdf"), width = 7, height = 3)
```

```{r generate-count-plots}
event_summary_table[,
  Variability := factor(
    sub(" Variability", "", Variability, fixed = TRUE),
    levels = c("High", "Low")
  )
]
event_summary_table[,
  `Event Type` := factor(`Event Type`, levels = c("SE", "RI"))
]

event_count_dt <- event_summary_table[
  has_model == TRUE,
  {
    counts <- .SD[, .(count = .N), by = response][, count]
    .(
      mean_count = mean(counts),
      sd_count = sd(counts) / sqrt(uniqueN(response))
    )
  },
  by = .(
    `Event Type`,
    response_type,
    expression_bias,
    Variability,
    rotated_hit
  )
]

event_count_dt[response_type == "real", response_type := "Real"]
event_count_dt[response_type == "rotated", response_type := "Rotated"]
event_count_dt[,
  response_type := factor(response_type, levels = c("Real", "Rotated"))
]
event_count_dt[
  expression_bias == "Expression Bias",
  expression_bias := "Expression\nBias"
]
event_count_dt[
  expression_bias == "Epigenetic Only",
  expression_bias := "Epigenetic\nOnly"
]
event_count_dt[
  order(Variability, decreasing = TRUE),
  cumsum_mean_count := cumsum(mean_count),
  by = .(`Event Type`, response_type, expression_bias)
]

ggplot(
  event_count_dt,
  aes(y = mean_count, x = expression_bias, fill = Variability)
) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_grid(`Event Type` ~ response_type, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.box = "vertical",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = variability_colors) +
  labs(y = "Number of Events") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      y = cumsum_mean_count,
      ymin = cumsum_mean_count - sd_count,
      ymax = cumsum_mean_count + sd_count
    ),
    width = .2
  )
ggsave(
  file.path(plot_dir_ev, "events_rotation.png"),
  width = 6,
  height = 3,
  dpi = 600
)

event_count_dt[
  response_type == "Real",
  expression_bias := sub("\n", " ", expression_bias, fixed = TRUE)
]
ggplot(
  event_count_dt[response_type == "Real"],
  aes(y = mean_count, x = Variability, fill = expression_bias)
) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  geom_text(aes(label = mean_count), position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5)) +
  facet_grid(`Event Type` ~ rotated_hit, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.box = "vertical",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(`Epigenetic Only` = "orange", `Expression Bias` = "steelblue")
  ) +
  labs(y = "Proportion of Events", fill = NULL)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir_ev, "events_hit.png"), width = 5, height = 3)
```

```{r cv-metrics-plot}
# CV R² distribution: real PSI vs rotated negative controls
cv_rsq_dt <- cv_metrics_table[.metric == "rsq_trad_psi"]
cv_rsq_dt[event_dt, on = "ID", `Event Type` := `Event Type`]
cv_rsq_dt[, `Event Type` := factor(`Event Type`, levels = to_analyze)]

ggplot(
  cv_rsq_dt,
  aes(x = response_type, y = .estimate, color = feature_set)
) +
  geom_violin(alpha = .5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_jitter(
    alpha = .2,
    position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.8, jitter.width = 0.5),
    size = .5
  ) +
  facet_grid(`Event Type` ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "CV R² (PSI scale)")
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir_ev, "cv_rsq_distribution.pdf"), width = 5, height = 4)
```

```{r plot-mark-counts}
# NOTE: activeChromHMM, event_gr, downstream_gr, upstream_gr must be
# loaded in the session (defined in earlier notebooks 01-08).
activeChromHMM_dt <- data.table(
  region = activeChromHMM$name,
  chrom_state = activeChromHMM$chrom_state,
  region_width = width(activeChromHMM),
  region_ID = seq_along(activeChromHMM)
)
coef_table[
  activeChromHMM_dt,
  on = "region",
  c("chrom_state", "region_width", "region_ID") := .(
    chrom_state,
    region_width,
    region_ID
  )
]

err_dt <- coef_table[
  mark != "(Intercept)" &
    expression_bias == "Epigenetic Only" &
    response_type == "real",
  .(mark = unique(mark)),
  by = .(ID, response, response_type, `Event Type`, Variability)
][,
  {
    counts <- .SD[, .(count = .N), by = response][, count]
    .(
      mean_count = mean(counts),
      sd_count = sd(counts) / sqrt(uniqueN(response))
    )
  },
  by = .(`Event Type`, response_type, mark, Variability)
]

err_dt[,
  Response := factor(
    fifelse(response_type == "real", "Real", "Rotated"),
    levels = c("Real", "Rotated")
  )
]
err_dt[,
  Variability := factor(
    sub(" Variability", "", Variability, fixed = TRUE),
    levels = c("Low", "High")
  )
]
err_dt[, `Event Type` := factor(`Event Type`, levels = c("SE", "RI"))]
err_dt[, mark := tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", mark))]

hex_colors <- c(
  mark_hex_colors,
  summed_enhancer = "darkorange",
  max_promoter = "tomato"
)
plot_colors <- setNames(
  rep("dark grey", err_dt[, uniqueN(mark)]),
  err_dt[, unique(mark)]
)
names(hex_colors) <- tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", names(hex_colors)))
for (name in names(hex_colors)) {
  inds <- startsWith(names(plot_colors), name)
  plot_colors[inds] <- hex_colors[name]
}

ggplot(err_dt, aes(x = Response, y = mean_count, fill = mark)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_count - sd_count, ymax = mean_count + sd_count),
    width = .7,
    position = position_dodge(.9)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(`Event Type` ~ Variability, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL, fill = "Mark") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = plot_colors) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir_ev, "mark_counts_error.pdf"), width = 6.1, height = 4)
```
